final:
rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0 and k < 8
  ex rotl8(1 as u8, 1) == 2 as u8
  ex rotl8(128 as u8, 1) == 1 as u8
  bits.rotate_left(x, k)

test_rotl8() =
  assert rotl8(1 as u8, 0) == 1 as u8
  assert rotl8(1 as u8, 1) == 2 as u8
  assert rotl8(128 as u8, 1) == 1 as u8
  assert rotl8(128 as u8, 2) == 2 as u8
